# §0. WHERE WE ARE — 2026-09-07

state.

Older build-list entries, newest first: [docs/status-archive.md](status-archive.md).

## ⏭ 0.00 PICK UP HERE — 2026-10-26

Everything here is live on readthegame.co and was checked in a real browser; gates, deploy and derive green.

### Live now
- **2026-10-29** (Kevin): after a goal, the replay soft-pauses for a fixed 20 s (`GOAL_READ_MS`, tuned 4 → 10 → 20 s live) at every speed so the board and notes can be read. Centre-ice overlay in `.iceslot` (svg only — not `.rinkbox`, whose % put it on the teaching text): under the circle, row layout so a phone ice still fits, `--muted` + ice text-shadow. "Tap Play to continue" / "or the replay continues in N seconds" plus Pause that freezes (then Resume / Play). Play continues at once while ticking; waiting auto-continues; Next clears it. Preview `GOAL_HOLD_MS` unchanged. Deploy check `gread-on-ice` asserts the bbox stays on the ice at 1024 and 390.
- **2026-10-29**: tracked goals now count the penalty box down on the clip clock; a power play ends on screen when its penalty does (first logic change to CC's design: box.js stays a non-strength model; the badge only drops a recorded power play, never adds one).
- **2026-10-29**: the summary card no longer opens with the attempts verdict; the per-team counts below already show attempts.
- **2026-10-29**: the build list was split into status.md + status-archive.md, and the README now matches the layer picker. `terrain-3d.html` and its builder were removed, and the `lab` branch was deleted.
- **2026-10-28** (Kevin): in Goals, a clip whose tracking shows the puck's dot clearing the attacking blue line ahead of that team's skaters holds on that frame (the same still as the opening frame). The line glows faintly on the way in. Each attacking skater gets a check, and the caption says the puck crossed before any of that team did. A clip that does not show the entry shows nothing. Event mode is unchanged. Reduced motion keeps the caption and leaves the line still.
- **2026-10-28** (Kevin, option B): in Goals, a located goal says how often shots from that distance go in, in 5-foot bands (`shotDistance` in `measures.json`). Blocked shots and empty nets are left out, every situation is counted, and a band under 30 attempts is not quoted. An empty-net goal says the net was empty instead of a rate. Event mode does not show the line.
- **2026-10-27** (Kevin), corrected 2026-10-28: the per-event source note was removed from Goals replay only and kept in Event mode (All events). It describes the site, not the event, so Goals keeps the color line as plain text. A site-level home for that disclosure is still open. The space under the Goals caption now carries the distance line.
- **2026-10-27** (`3f28aa8`…`32fabf7`): the empty-net strength sentence uses `standing()` from `strength.js`,
  so a goal by the team that pulled its goalie (1560 home, 0651 away) says the net is empty. Roster names and
  jerseys are escaped at the caption, the who-line, the why-popup and the goaltending cards, and `test/esc.test.js`
  fails when `p.nm` / `p.n` are interpolated into HTML raw. A tip-in primary assist is called the shot only when
  that touch is the release (the same ~3-tenth window).
- **2026-10-27** (`7547aef`…`0a34b9e`): Goals mode says one thing at a time under the rink; "where these notes
  come from" closes on a new frame; goal banner at centre ice. **Assist stops** in tracked goals (who from the
  league's a1/a2, when from the tracking: nearest within 5.5 ft; 319/344 primary found on a 367-goal sample).
  Goals passes through non-stop frames with no reading pause (was 5.4 s). **Shootout stop** in Goals. **Assists
  lesson** (rules card, `census.assists` 20,238/4,818/1,710 of 26,766, methods `#m-assists`). Kevin kept the
  editions ruling: shared replay links keep `asof` and that night's code (trade-off 4) — test with plain links.
- **Front door trimmed** (`4ea602c`, `5448721`): the hero is kicker + clubs + button (attempts lede and archive rate
  removed; Kevin: details live inside the site) — phone hero 1053→766 px, button now above the fold. Puck note: "This
  season's goals come with an addition: … we also draw the puck and every skater moving." Tracking stays 2026-27 only
  (NHL permission pending); fetching a second season makes "this season's" false.
- **Goals mode is the default on a plain visit** (`be30e48`): a game link with no `at=` and no `summary=1`, on a game
  with tracked goals (this season only). Links to a moment (lesson doors, shared moments) open in All events unless
  `replay=goals`; `replay=all` asks for All events. The newcomer note describes whichever mode is showing.
- **Goals mode walks** first frame → recorded events → the shot → the goal → the next goal. One goal is one stop:
  the goal frame holds the tracked goal-line picture (`trkRest`, class `trkrest`), banner in the other half
  (`284b2ae`, `840917f`). The scrubber goes where it is tapped. A goal that came off on review is a stop
  ("Face-off after a review · TOR's goal came off").
- **Lanes** (`src/lib/tracked.js`): a light dashed triangle from the puck to the posts while the puck is in the scoring
  end beyond 20 ft (`trackLaneAt`); on goals beyond 20 ft it darkens and holds from the shot to the goal line
  (`trackShot`). The shot's moment: beyond 30 ft the release nearest the recorded spot, within 30 the frame nearest it.
  `TRACK_LANE_FT` 20 (visual), `TRACK_RELEASE_FT` 30, `TRACK_CARRY_FT` 3.5, `TRACK_TURN_DEG` 45 — all declared choices.
- **Challenges** (`src/lib/challenge.js`): the outcome of every review of a goal, read from the record, said on the
  first frame after it; the stoppage card names the goal as what stopped play; `census.reviews` published
  ("coaches have won 490 of 726 challenges of a goal, about 2 in 3").
- **The hero** rolls from the text replay into its first goal as tracked (`e779d42`); **share links** carry `replay`
  and `speed` (`08a4eee`); base rates say "Across the 4,345 games we have measured".
